node.content-desc: !, Looks like you have configured linking in multiple places. This is likely an error since deep links should only be handled in one place to avoid conflicts. Make sure that: - You don't have multiple NavigationContainers in the app each with 'linking' enabled - Only a single instance of the root component is rendered
